description: This Kotlin source file defines the 'TagsFragment' class, a UI component in an Android application responsible for displaying and managing a list of tags. It handles user interactions such as creating, sorting, selecting, and deleting tags, and integrates with various UI utilities and view models to coordinate data flow and navigation.

classes.name: TagsFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass that displays and manages a list of tags with sorting, selection, and editing capabilities in an Android app.

methods.description: Inflates the menu with tag-related actions.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections for creating, sorting, and other tag actions.

methods.description: Cleans up references to adapters before the view is destroyed.

methods.description: Retrieves and sorts the list of tags according to user-selected preferences, then displays them.
